Title: Dual Discipline Cards : ei True Love's Face (newbie)

Messages.Author: Tallens
Messages.Body:
Hi Community

I was trying to look for an explanation as to, dual disciplines, a friend and I was discussing this to quite some heat.

we are both "new" to VTES in the sense we have just begun playing again after 10 years off.

So we are puzzled as to "who can use the card"

> Name: True Love's Face
> [KMW:C, LotN:PS4]
> Cardtype: Action Modifier
> Discipline: Obfuscate & Presence
> [obf] +1 bleed. You cannot play another action modifier to increase this bleed amount.
> [OBF] Only usable when a minion attempts to block. That block fails (do not tap that minion). That minion cannot attempt to block this action again. That minion's controller may burn a pool to cancel this card as it is played.
>
Our Quetion is. does the Minion Using the card need to have Superior in BOTH OBF and PRE to use the second ability, or can this be done by having OBF or PRE.

/T

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body: Both levels require both disciplines each.  and  for the first effect, and  and  for the second effect.

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
The absolute only card i can name off the top of my head that requirez two disciplines but only needs one at superior to gain the superior effect is elemental stoicism.
Everything else can be played only at basic if the minion lacks both at superior. If count germaine (has big PRE basic obf) or evan klein (big OBF small pre) play true loves face, they only have access to the inferior version(the bleed pump) unless some effect gives them superior of both.
